options.reason: The table is a CPTAC-BRCA proteomics matrix assembled for predicting oestrogen-receptor status: 120 samples with ~12,600 protein-abundance features and a single two-level outcome column 'label' (0/1, 81 vs 39), so binary classification with 'label' as the only target and the protein columns as features. sample_id is a row key and is excluded as a feature; no column recodes or post-dates the target, so no leakage suspects and no group or time columns apply.
options.title: binary
